question: Is the simulator's Season 2 backtest advantage over the champion blend / Elo real?

leakage_checklist.item: Outcome distributions fitted on Season 1 only
leakage_checklist.evidence: scripts/backtest_simulator.py builds distributions from bb[bb.match_id.isin(s1_ids)] (S1 match IDs only) before simulating any S2 match.

leakage_checklist.item: Player priors computed as of before Season 2
leakage_checklist.evidence: backtest_simulator.py uses BT._priors_asof(2025-11-17) -- the S2 start -- so no S2 delivery is inside a prior.

leakage_checklist.item: Playing XIs are the ACTUAL Season 2 XIs (post-hoc)
leakage_checklist.evidence: XIs come from data/final/parquet/match_lineups.parquet -- the XIs that actually played, knowable only at the toss. The live P1 is also post-XI-announcement, so the deployment task is comparable, but the backtest cannot capture announcement-time uncertainty (late changes, players who were announced but did not play).

leakage_checklist.item: Simulator constants chosen without using Season 2 results
leakage_checklist.evidence: K_BAT_SIM=100, K_BOWL_SIM=120 (src/prediction/simulator.py), phase definitions (Powerplay/Middle/Death from the data's phase column) and n_sims=2000 are fixed in code, but there is NO pre-registered record of when they were set relative to the S2 backtest, so tuning-against-S2 cannot be ruled out from the artefacts alone.

Backtest used 2,000 sims/match: Monte Carlo standard error on a win probability is ~sqrt(0.25/2000) = 0.011 per match. The paired bootstrap treats p_sim as fixed, so true uncertainty is slightly wider than the reported CIs.

leakage_checklist.item: Outcome (y) is the target, never an input
leakage_checklist.evidence: y is derived from matches.winner_name after simulation; no outcome field is read by build_distributions or simulate_match.

verdict_rule: Pre-committed: if the 95% CI for the simulator - champion per-match log-loss difference includes 0, the verdict is 'advantage not established'.
promotion_rule_unchanged: The simulator stays in shadow mode; promotion requires beating the champion on the Season 3 frozen log, not on this backtest.
